objective: Preallocate TABLE DDL schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate TABLE schema keys
tasks.result: CREATE TABLE, foreign-key validation, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE TABLE, and ALTER TABLE schema lookups now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in CREATE TABLE existence checks, foreign-key parent schema validation, schema storage, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE TABLE, and ALTER TABLE schema loading.
Generated schema key bytes, table creation, foreign-key validation, drop/truncate cleanup, row-cache invalidation, ALTER TABLE behavior, and DDL outputs are unchanged.
An attempted multi-filter cargo test command failed before running tests because cargo test accepts a single TESTNAME filter; focused filters were then run independently.
git diff --check printed the existing CRLF normalization warning for src/execution/ddl/table.rs while exiting successfully.
